title: HFEMCNet: A Compact Hybrid Frequency Enriched Multi Channel Network for Automatic Modulation Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.22139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) of received radio signals is prudent for further signal processing tasks such as communication monitoring, cognitive radio operation, and interference mitigation in the electromagnetic spectrum. Traditional methods often rely on handcrafted features and struggle under complex channel conditions, whereas deep learning (DL) architectures can learn discriminative representations directly from raw signals. In this work, we propose HFEMCNet, a novel compact hybrid frequency-enriched multi-channel network that jointly exploits spatiotemporal dependencies and frequency domain information derived via Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). HFEMCNet integrates raw IQ samples with hierarchical spectral features to produce a rich signal representation, which is processed by convolutional layers for spatial feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) units for temporal modeling. translated_title: HFEMCNet：一种用于自动调制分类的紧凑型混合频率增强多通道网络
translated_abstract: 对接收到的无线电信号进行自动调制分类（AMC）对于通信监测、认知无线电运行以及电磁频谱中的干扰抑制等后续信号处理任务至关重要。传统方法通常依赖手工设计的特征，在复杂信道条件下表现不佳，而深度学习（DL）架构能够直接从原始信号中学习判别性表示。在这项工作中，我们提出了HFEMCNet，这是一种新颖的紧凑型混合频率增强多通道网络，它联合利用时空依赖关系和通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）获得的频域信息。HFEMCNet将原始IQ采样与分层频谱特征相结合，以生成丰富的信号表示，该表示由卷积层进行空间特征提取，并由长短期记忆（LSTM）单元进行时间建模。在（此处摘要原文被截断）上的实验评估表明……
tldr: 提出了一种紧凑型混合网络HFEMCNet，通过融合原始IQ采样与FFT频谱特征，并利用卷积层和LSTM进行时空联合建模，实现了复杂信道条件下鲁棒的自动调制分类。
en_tdlr: HFEMCNet is a compact hybrid multi-channel network that fuses raw IQ samples with FFT-derived hierarchical spectral features and employs convolutional layers and LSTM units for joint spatiotemporal modeling, enabling robust automatic modulation classification under complex channel conditions.
